H6753.name: Hazzelelponi
H6753.desc: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H6753.brief: A woman mentioned in the genealogy of Judah.
H6753.short: Hazzelelponi was a woman mentioned in the genealogy of Judah.

H6721G.name: Sidon
H6721G.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H6721G.brief: Firstborn son of Canaan, ancestor of the Sidonians.
H6721G.short: Sidon was the firstborn son of Canaan and the ancestor of the Sidonian people.

H6764.name: Zalaph
H6764.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H6764.brief: Father of Hanun, who repaired Jerusalem's wall
H6764.short: Zalaph was the father of Hanun, who repaired a section of Jerusalem's wall.

H6756B.name: Zalmon
H6756B.desc: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
H6756B.short: Zalmon, also known as Ilai, was one of King David's mighty men, hailing from Ahlai.

H6759.name: Zalmunna
H6759.short: Zalmunna was a Midianite king who was defeated and killed by Gideon during the time of the judges.

H6768.name: Zelek
H6768.desc: Warrior Ammonite living at the time of United Monarchy
H6768.brief: Ammonite, one of David's mighty men
H6768.short: Zelek the Ammonite was one of David's mighty men.

H6765.name: Zelophehad
H6765.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H6765.brief: Israelite whose daughters received his inheritance
H6765.short: Zelophehad, a descendant of Manasseh, had no sons, so his daughters appealed for and received his inheritance.

H6786.name: Zemarites
H6786.short: The Zemarites were a Canaanite people group mentioned in the Table of Nations.

H6717.name: Ziba
H6717.desc: David's compatriot living at the time of United Monarchy
H6717.brief: Servant of Saul's household, later served David
H6717.short: Ziba, a servant of Saul's household, became a servant of David and played a role in the conflict between David and Mephibosheth.

H6727G.name: Ziha
H6727G.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H6727G.brief: Family of temple servants who returned from exile
H6727G.short: Ziha was a family of temple servants (Nethinim) who returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian captivity.

H6727H.name: Ziha
H6727H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H6727H.brief: Family of temple servants living on the Ophel
H6727H.short: The temple servants, including the family of Ziha, lived on Ophel in Jerusalem during the time of Nehemiah.

H6741.name: Zillah
H6741.desc: Woman living at the time before the Flood
H6741.brief: Wife of Lamech; mother of Tubal-Cain and Naamah
H6741.short: Zillah, one of Lamech's two wives, was the mother of Tubal-Cain, the first metalworker, and Naamah.

H6769H.name: Zillethai
H6769H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6769H.brief: Manassite leader who joined David at Ziklag
H6769H.short: Zillethai, a leader from the tribe of Manasseh, was one of the men who joined David at Ziklag.

H6769G.name: Zillethai
H6769G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6769G.short: Zillethai was a son of Shimei and a descendant of Benjamin.

H6714G.name: Zohar
H6714G.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H6714G.short: Zohar was the father of Ephron the Hittite, from whom Abraham purchased the cave of Machpelah as a burial site.

H6700.name: Zuriel
H6700.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H6700.short: Zuriel was the leader of the Merarite Levites during the wilderness wanderings.

H6701.name: Zurishaddai
H6701.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H6701.brief: Father of Shelumiel, leader of Simeon
H6701.short: Zurishaddai was the father of Shelumiel, a leader of the tribe of Simeon during the wilderness wanderings.

H6713.name: Sahar
H6713.brief: Unknown location mentioned in Ezekiel's prophecy
H6713.short: Sahar is a place mentioned in Ezekiel's prophecy, but its exact location is unknown (<ref="Ezk. 27:18">Ezk. 27:18</ref>).

H6721H.name: Sidon
H6721H.short: Sidon, also called Great Sidon, was a prominent Phoenician city known for its trade and culture, and was the hometown of Jezebel, wife of King Ahab (<ref="1Ki. 16:31">1Ki. 16:31</ref>). It is mentioned in various contexts throughout the Bible, including the Old Testament (<ref="Gen. 10:19; Josh. 11:8; Judg. 10:6; Isa. 23:2-4; Jer. 27:3; Ezek. 28:21-22">Gen. 10:19; Josh. 11:8; Judg. 10:6; Isa. 23:2-4; Jer. 27:3; Ezek. 28:21-22</ref>) and the New Testament (<ref="Matt. 11:21-22; Luke 4:26; Act.27.3">Matt. 11:21-22; Luke 4:26; Act.27.3</ref>).

H6758.name: Zalmonah
H6758.brief: A place where the Israelites camped during their wilderness journey
H6758.short: Zalmonah, a campsite of the Israelites during their wilderness journey, located between Mount Hor and Punon (<ref="Num. 33:41-42">Num. 33:41-42</ref>).

H6762.name: Zela
H6762.brief: A city in Benjamin where Saul's family was buried
H6762.short: Zela was a city in Benjamin where Saul and his family were buried .

H6766.name: Zelzah
H6766.brief: A place near Rachel's tomb in Benjamin
H6766.short: Zelzah was a place near Rachel's tomb in Benjamin that Samuel referenced when giving directions to Saul .

H6787.name: Zemaraim
H6787.brief: A town in Benjamin; also a hill in Ephraim
H6787.short: Zemaraim was a town allotted to Benjamin (<ref="Jos.18.22">Jos.18.22</ref>). Mount Zemaraim in Ephraim was where Abijah addressed Jeroboam's army .

H6799.name: Zenan
H6799.brief: A town in the Judean lowlands
H6799.short: Zenan was a town in the lowlands of Judah .

H6790.name: Zin
H6790.brief: A desert and wilderness region south of Judah
H6790.short: The Wilderness of Zin was a desert region south of Judah where the Israelites encamped during their wilderness wanderings .

H6730.name: Zior
H6730.brief: A town in the hill country of Judah
H6730.short: Zior was a town in the hill country of Judah .

H6732.name: Ziz
H6732.brief: A pass where Jehoshaphat defeated Moab and Ammon
H6732.short: The Ascent of Ziz was a pass where Jehoshaphat defeated the armies of Moab and Ammon .
